text: A large, two handed, shaped stick for bashing enemies. Extreme weight at the end of this tool allows user to crush flesh and bones alike, leaving enemies maimed, paralysed and often dead.
A small, one handed club. Whilst it's fast to swing, it is not going to cause tremendous damage due to its low weight and short length.

A sharp piece of rock mounted on a sturdy piece of wood. Often used as a tool, it has been recorded that tribal axes also served as a great weapon due to their small size and ability to inflict deep wounds.
One of mankind's oldest manufactured objects. A shiv is a short but sharp piece of rock or metal with a small handle.
A small pouch in the middle of two lengths of cord. Used to slingshot sharp rocks over medium distance.
A set of crude rock or metal shards that can be thrown a short distance.
A small clay pot with various flammable substances inside - be it chemfuel, cloth, gunpowder or animal fats.
